Messages.Author: Bhobbit
Messages.Body:
Evening, guys.

Lucian, the Perfect, for example, bleeds his prey and uses +2 stealth. The bleed is redirected to me (Lucian's methuselah predator). I have two vampires available for blocking, but only one of them has enough intercept to do it. One of my vampires is Valerius Maior, Hell's Fool. On purpose, I say that Valerius tries to block, even without having or playing any intercept on him during the action, just to activate his power. He announces trying to block, but fails, leaving Lucian unable to increase stealth with Obfuscation, correct? So, I can block with the other vampire without any problems.

The question is: If an action already has stealth, does Valerius must have/play intercept on him for his "attempts to block" text to work?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body: You don't block with both minion at the same time. The moment you start blocking with another minion Valerius is not attempting anymore.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Bhobbit wrote:
> Evening, guys.
>
> Lucian, the Perfect, for example, bleeds his prey and uses +2 stealth. The bleed is redirected to me (Lucian's methuselah predator). I have two vampires available for blocking, but only one of them has enough intercept to do it. One of my vampires is Valerius Maior, Hell's Fool. On purpose, I say that Valerius tries to block, even without having or playing any intercept on him during the action, just to activate his power. He announces trying to block, but fails, leaving Lucian unable to increase stealth with Obfuscation, correct?
>
Correct.
Valerius' effect triggers as soon as he is attempting to block, and lasts until the end of the action (his cardtext is not "while Valerius is attempting to block...", it's a trigger).
groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/vet0HGRxtXQ/m/gRJalPv4lLoJ

> Bhobbit wrote:
> The question is: If an action already has stealth, does Valerius must have/play intercept on him for his "attempts to block" text to work?
>
No. You can attempt to block with minions lacking intercept (otherwise, you wouldn't be able to add intercept). And you MUST declare block attempts before adding intercept.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Body:

Rulebook:
A minion can attempt to block as many times as they wish as long as another minion is not already blocking.

Furthermore, the effect is applied on the acting minion (that remains the same for the current action) and not on Valerius himself

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
Then why does not effect stay on until the end of the turn / game?
Unless duration is specified it seems reasonable to read "if TEMPORARY CONDDITION then TEMPORARY EFFECT" to last until temporary condition is present and not for some very arbitrary duration like action/turn/game.

Imo Valerius need text improvement or this template deserve standard explanation in the rulebook (like "during x do y").

Messages.Author: acbishop
Messages.Body:
Valerius is still trying to block the action till a card played would say the block attempt fails and that minion cannot attempt to block again.

So, action at +1 stealth, Valerius tries to block at 0 intercept, minion B of Valerius' controller tries to block adding intercept. Note that Valerius hasn't declined to block or any card made his attempt to block to fail, technically he is still trying to block

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
>Valerius is still trying to block

No he does not. Per rulebook I cited above you can try to attempt as many times as you want, even if you don't have enough cept, but you MUST (temporary) stop attempting by one minion to attempt to block with another one and that open the window if we assume Valerius special only work while he is attempting to block.
And if we assume his special triggers once and works indefinitely even after he's not blocking, then my question is why it won't last until the end of the game and only until the end of the action.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
> smeeag wrote:
> Then why does not effect stay on until the end of the turn / game?
>
The effect lasts for as long as the target is the acting vampire which is only as long as the duration of a given action.

"If Valerius attempts to block, the acting minion cannot play action modifier [...]"

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
That the text could be more elaborate and more explicit it always can, but imo that doesn´t mean it isn´t clear as it currently is worded.

> If Valerius attempts to block, the acting minion cannot play action modifier or combat cards that require Chimerstry or Obfuscate .
>
"If Valerius attempts to block" = condition when the effect would trigger, it is not a continues check kind of activation as for that it would need to be worded eg "while Valerius attempts to block"

"the acting minion cannot play action modifier or combat cards that require Chimerstry or Obfuscate ." = the actual effect (that is a modifier type effect) applied on the acting minion, like all modifier effects they only last for the duration of the action that is being affected if not explicitly stated otherwise.

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> that is a modifier type effect) applied on the acting minion, like all modifier effects
>
That is not modifier type effect. That is effect without specified duration and that is why I assume it duration must be either limited by duration of triggering condition ("while Valerius is attempting to block") or it will last as long as we want it to be (end of action, turn, game...).
See Arnulf text which is similar:
: If Arnulf attempts to block, the acting minion cannot play action modifier cards requiring Dementation, Dominate, Necromancy or Presence
until the end of the action.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Whether you agree with it being a modifier type effect or not doesn´t change that it is, this because it affects the action as a whole and what can be done during the action by the acting and non-acting, the effect is similar to/no different than making an action eg unblockable.

Here you have a ruling that makes it clear that modifier type effect can be sourced from other card types than action modifiers.
www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/80984-haqim-s-law-retribution-efect-during-combat?start=12#109917

With regards to the wording that you provide ("until the end of the action.") is part of the newer templating that has been added to be more explicit about how it works but is in no way changing the effect which was rules the same by LSJ,back at 2005, with the same reasoning that the card text doesn't state "while Valerius is attempting to block".
groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/vet0HGRxtXQ/m/gRJalPv4lLoJ

Below is a card that uses the "while" format and functions as you are expecting.

Libertas

Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Requires an Anarch.
Put this card on an Anarch. Allies cannot block this Anarch. Cards requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence  cost other minions +1 blood while this Anarch is acting, attempting to block or in combat.
